g.text: What the unchanged model actually used: three held-out decisions
Exact decomposition: sum of 480 colored cells + fixed offset (-3.07) = scissors-minus-rock score.
Score differences: trial 44: -56.62; trial 8: +38.64; trial 65: +59.89. Negative favors rock; positive favors scissors (paper must also be compared).
All three trials were held out from the SAME model (repeat 1, fold 8; training 81, testing 9). No new feature selection or tuning.
This explains the fitted LDA calculation, not the biological cause of a movement or an error. Labels are instruction cues.
